programmes.d: When a Hollywood camera crew set out to film an active volcano they end up in a helicopter crash into the active volcano. All rescue attempts are delayed by lava, toxic gases and bad weather.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: An ER Miracle
programmes.d: A young boy is taken to the ER after being in a horrific accident. His head is severed and doctors race to save his life.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Rottweiler In The ER
programmes.d: While a shooting victim is brought to the hospital, a Rottweiler gets loose in the ER; a young mother's asthma attack turns quickly into a deadly heart failure; a young man comes into the ER comatose, covered with a mysterious rash.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Dumpster Smash
programmes.d: A man who's been smashed by a dumpster barely clings to life; an elderly nun and an inebriated, screaming prostitute come into the ER at the same time; a woman dying of an apparent stroke may be suffering from a rare disease.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: No Down Time
programmes.d: Dr. Castillo thought he had seen it all in the ER, until a seven-foot-tall man is brought into the ER, blind drunk and unconscious.
A young Indigenous woman goes missing during a visit from her remote hometown and the clock is ticking as police use the latest computer forensics to track down her last known whereabout.
When a young Indigenous woman is brutally murdered in Northern Manitoba, four suspects go free...for over a decade.
The story of 27-year-old Pawel Relowicz, who raped and killed 21-year-old Hull student Libby Squire in a case that made headlines around the UK.
In 2010, Derek Bird took his gun and, in less than twenty-four hours, killed twelve people and injured eleven more. He stopped when he had run out of ammunition, finally turning the gun on himself.
An amateur photographer is exploring a beautiful cove in British Columbia when he falls 20ft from a cliff.
A British hiker spends 10 days stranded in the mountains of New Zealand following a crippling fall.
When 2 best friends take a Kayaking trip, they are hoping for nothing less than a great adventure. Powerful currents and bad weather quickly expose how one is inexperienced and both, in grave danger.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Family Tragedy
programmes.d: A mother and son are brought in after a horrific car accident. The son was not wearing a seat belt during the crash and was ejected from the car.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Stabbed In The Heart
programmes.d: A stabbing victim's heart has a hole in it, and must be pumped by hand to keep him alive; a woman believes that she is possessed by demons; a man with a vibrator in his rectum offers to pay cash to keep his condition off of his medical record.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Officer Down
programmes.d: A policeman is struck by a speeding driver seeking revenge, which may leave him with no legs. A team of doctors try and save the officer's life.
An Olympic hero shoots his girlfriend at his home in the middle of the night. Has he mistaken her for an intruder or is it all part of a precisely calculated plot to get away with murder?
